body.title: Pin the pre-change projection identity
body.summary: Before any behaviour change, add the deterministic fixture (fixed author/committer identity and dates, explicit merge messages, isolated git config) with a selected change, interleaved commits and a merge that leave the selected path untouched, and a selected rename; compute its projectionIdentity with the current pathContinuity and pin it as a constant in projection-lineage.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: The pinned-identity test passes against the unchanged code, and the constant was produced by that code.
Running the fixture twice yields the same commit OIDs and identity.

tests.name: projection identity matches the identity pinned from the code before the change
